kpis.label: $10B EXIM loan + ~$2B private capital; demand-driven stockpile tied to OEM offtake commitments (GM and others)
$2.9B DoD/DoE/EXIM blitz, DoC's $1.6B LOI/equity stake in USA Rare Earth, and Energy Fuels' $725M DoW loan for terbium/dysprosium buildout
Terbium oxide ~$1,033/kg, NdPr oxide ~$114/kg domestic China — off its early-2026 peak above 300 but still sharply elevated
Deal for the only non-Asia mine producing all 4 magnetic rare earths at scale; shareholder vote set for Aug 28, 2026

themes.title: Beijing weaponizing processing dominance
themes.description: China's Rare Earth Price Index held at 272.2 on Jul 14 (terbium oxide ~$1,033/kg, NdPr oxide ~$114/kg domestic); the Oct-2025 US-China truce and tariff suspension run through Nov 10, 2026 — a key overhang for ex-China supply.

themes.title: Enforcement gets more active
themes.description: Beijing's Jun 22 entity list (MP Materials, USA Rare Earth) is now paired with MOFCOM's formal violation-reporting mechanism; two Japanese nationals were detained in Dalian in May 2026 on alleged rare-earth-related smuggling charges, signaling tighter enforcement.

themes.title: Washington's playbook
themes.description: Project Vault's $10B EXIM loan + ~$2B private capital is structured around OEM offtake commitments (GM and others), not central planning; layered on top is ~$2.9B in direct DoD/DoE/EXIM funding plus Energy Fuels' new $725M DoW loan and USA Rare Earth's $1.6B DoC stake.

tiers.label: Established Producers
tiers.note: Tiered by maturity/risk — not a ranked buy list.

rows.angle: Only US rare-earth mine + processing (Mountain Pass); $500M Apple magnet offtake (shipments from 2027) + $400M DoD convertible preferred (DoD now largest shareholder, ~15%)
rows.watch for: DoD-backed "10X" magnet plant (commissioning 2028, 10,000t/yr capacity) carries a 10-year, 100%-offtake commitment at a $110/kg NdPr oxide price floor; stock remains volatile after China's Jun 22 entity-list addition

rows.angle: Largest non-China rare-earth producer (Australia/Malaysia); pushing into magnet metals
rows.watch for: Placing up to 1,873,386 unsecured convertible notes (Aug 6) to fund growth; shares down ~21% on the month and into oversold territory despite the Jul 22 record-revenue quarter (A$288.9M, +70% YoY)

Deferring capex on hard-rock expansion projects (announced Aug 1) to protect its balance sheet until lithium chemical prices stabilize; shares ~$117.7. Analysts now flag a possible 2026 shift from surplus to a 22,000–80,000t deficit

rows.angle: Copper — the electrification metal at scale
rows.watch for: Q2 beat: EPS $0.74 vs. $0.59 est. (+25%), revenue $7.03B vs. $6.71B est.; realized copper $6.17/lb as LME copper ran to $6.30/lb (+12% YTD) — but Grasberg (Indonesia) output fell 18% (copper) / 39% (gold)

tiers.label: Developers / Small-Cap — Speculative
tiers.note: Tiered by maturity/risk — not a ranked buy list.

rows.angle: US rare-earth mine-to-magnet aspirant; Texas mine + Oklahoma magnet plant; DoC $1.6B LOI + ~10% equity stake (Jan 2026, priced $17.17)
rows.watch for: Special shareholder meeting Aug 28 to approve issuing 126.85M new shares for the ~$2.8B Serra Verde (Brazil) acquisition, plus a possible adjournment to solicit more proxies; deal priced off USAR's $19.95 close Apr 17; on China's export-control entity list

rows.angle: Uranium + rare-earth processing at White Mesa
rows.watch for: Jul 29: announced plans to add terbium (Tb) and dysprosium (Dy) oxide production — final piece of its mine-to-magnet platform — backed by a $725M Dept. of War/DoD loan; ~29kg of 99.9%-pure Dy oxide produced at pilot scale; Q2 earnings call Aug 6

DoE $2.23B loan — $435M drawn, DoE holds 5% equity stake; shares stabilizing after a sharp Lithium Triangle selloff as some analysts flag a 2026 supply deficit (22,000–80,000t) forming behind the oversupply narrative

bear_case.title: Commodity cycles cut both ways
bear_case.description: Lithium's 2023–25 crash shows how fast oversupply can crush miners; Albemarle is now deferring hard-rock expansion capex to protect its balance sheet until prices stabilize, and Chile policy shifts are hitting SQM hardest across the Lithium Triangle.

bear_case.title: China can flood the market
bear_case.description: Beijing has historically dumped supply to crush Western rare-earth economics; price floors help but don't cover everyone.

bear_case.title: Juniors dilute
bear_case.description: Developers without cash flow fund construction via repeated equity raises; USAR/LAC-type names carry meaningful dilution risk.

bear_case.title: Policy dependency
bear_case.description: The thesis leans on sustained government support; a policy shift or trade détente removes a key prop.

catalysts.title: Lynas places convertible notes
catalysts.description: Up to 1,873,386 unsecured convertible notes via an ASX-listed placement to fund growth, as shares sit down ~21% on the month and into oversold territory.

catalysts.title: Albemarle defers lithium capex
catalysts.description: ALB is pushing out hard-rock expansion spending to protect its balance sheet until lithium chemical prices stabilize; shares ~$117.7 as some analysts now flag a possible 2026 swing to a 22,000–80,000t supply deficit.

catalysts.title: Lithium miners rally as Chile policy hits SQM
catalysts.description: LIT ETF gained 4.6% on the day led by Albemarle, even as new Chile policy pressured SQM hardest across the Lithium Triangle — a reminder the recovery is uneven.

catalysts.title: Energy Fuels advances mine-to-magnet buildout
catalysts.description: Announced plans to add terbium and dysprosium oxide production — the final piece of its integrated platform — backed by a $725M DoW/DoD loan; White Mesa Mill (Utah) is expanding heavy-rare-earth processing capacity.

catalysts.title: USA Rare Earth shareholder vote (upcoming)
catalysts.description: Special meeting to approve issuing 126.85M new shares for the ~$2.8B Serra Verde acquisition (Brazil's Pela Ema mine), plus a possible adjournment to solicit more proxies.

catalysts.title: US-China truce & tariff suspension expire (upcoming)
catalysts.description: Current general export licenses for rare earths/lithium-battery materials run through this date (gallium/germanium/antimony/superhard materials through Nov 27) — the sector's biggest swing factor if not extended.

etfs.name: Global X Lithium & Battery Tech
etfs.summary: Lithium chain from miners to battery makers; jumped 4.6% Jul 31 as Albemarle rallied, though the recovery remains uneven across the Lithium Triangle
